fn Fibo(n: Int) -> Int
  requires (n == n)
  ensures (result == (if (n <= 0) then 0 else if (n == 1) then 1 else (Fibo((n - 2)) + Fibo((n - 1)))))
  ensures (result >= 0)
  effects pure
  example (Fibo(0) == 0)
  example (Fibo(1) == 1)
{

fn Fibonacci(n: Int) -> List[Int]
  requires (Fibo(n) < 2147483648)
  requires (n >= 2)
  ensures (len(result) == n)
  ensures forall i in 2..n: (result[i] == Fibo(i))
  effects pure
  example (Fibonacci(0) == [])
{
  []
